key_insight: Ensembles of variational quantum regressors improve nonlinear regression accuracy, with sequential AdaBoost outperforming independently trained Bagging.
engineering_relevance: Combining imperfect quantum regressors offers a potential route to more accurate prediction on near-term quantum hardware without requiring fault tolerance.
method: Train quantum regressors independently with Bagging or sequentially with AdaBoost.
Select features systematically from first- and second-order polynomial terms.
Use repeated feature encoding in the feature-to-qubit mapping to improve accuracy.
evidence_signal: Evaluation on four benchmark functions of varying nonlinearity shows accuracy improving with both ensemble size and individual regressor size.
watch_item: The abstract does not establish practical quantum advantage or quantify hardware-noise robustness and ensemble training costs.
paper_title: Nonlinear function regression using quantum ensemble learning
